landing.title: Learn English in phrases,
landing.subtitle: Ustoz is an AI tutor that talks with you about your life, corrects mistakes like a teacher and brings every new phrase back just as you start to forget it.
landing.demoWhy: With photos we say take, not make.
landing.lessonKicker: A lesson is a real-life task
landing.lessonTitle: Not “Food”, but “Order plov in a choyxona”
landing.lessonText: Every lesson starts with a goal: what you will be able to do afterwards. Then ready-made phrases, practice at your level and a role-play mission with AI.
landing.step1Text: You know why you are learning these phrases.
landing.step2Text: Collocations and phrasal verbs with examples and typical mistakes.
landing.step3Text: Exercises are picked to be a little harder than easy.
landing.step4Text: A role-play: a waiter, a doctor or an HR manager waits for your answer.
landing.lessonCanDo: You will be able to order dishes, ask what is in them and ask for the bill.
landing.lessonMission: Mission: the waiter is waiting for your order
landing.srsTitle: A phrase comes back just as you start to forget it
landing.srsText: Answer fast and right, and the next review comes later. Make a mistake, and the phrase comes back tomorrow. That is how words reach long-term memory without cramming.
landing.srsTry: Press “Flip card” to see the back
landing.p1Text: Everything the tutor corrected in chat and exercises is collected in one place and practised until it sticks.
landing.p2Text: Listen to a model, record yourself and compare. Extra focus on th, w and v, the sounds learners miss most.
landing.p3Text: About 90% of the material is at your level and the rest a step above, so you progress without overload.
landing.p4Text: Interface and rules in Russian, Uzbek or English. English wherever you are learning it.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start for free. Cancel in one click.
landing.pMistakesFull: Detailed notes and a mistake bank
landing.pAiLessons: AI lessons for C1–C2 and personal lessons
landing.pTrial: 7 days of Pro free, no card needed
landing.q1: Do I need to install anything?
landing.a1: No. Ustoz works in the browser on your phone and computer. Chrome or Edge work best for the pronunciation trainer.
landing.a2: After sign-up you take a short 8-question test. You can change the level in settings at any time.
landing.q3: What happens when the daily limit runs out?
landing.a3: On Free you continue tomorrow: the limit resets at midnight Tashkent time. Plus has a bigger limit, Pro has none.
landing.q4: How do I pay for a subscription?
landing.a4: With an Uzcard or HUMO card, through Click, or with a Visa/Mastercard card. This is a study project: no real money is charged.
